caption: The drawing features a brown double-breasted overcoat with a notched collar that is rendered in a reddish-brown shade. The front of the coat shows six buttons arranged in two columns, with two visible flap pockets, one on the right chest and one on the left hip, and a small buttoned strap accent on the right sleeve. The inside of the coat’s front panel and collar lining is illustrated with a blue, green, and yellow plaid pattern. In the background, there is a simple line sketch of the back view of the same coat, showing the outline and placement of a horizontal seam and an additional pocket flap at hip height. The drawing is executed on a plain beige background. At the bottom left, there is a handwritten caption with the name "Louis Heldorelli" and the date "June 19, 1937."
title: Man's Coat
